propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos annua beatae Caeciliae Virginis et Martyris tuae solemnitate
laetificas: da, ut, quam veneramur officio, etiam piae conversationis sequamur
exemplo. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Whole own bilingual prayer crosses printed1292/1293 before Epistle referral. Donor lacks target comma after ut; complete Latin words and actual Per Dominum./Through our Lord. agree. Cecilia is the literal printed English name. Own Prayer under Nov22 StCecilia, MassLoquebar except; no Common prayer substituted. interventione nos refove, cujus solemnia celebramus. Per Dominum.
